summary: Tested VIP suggest endpoint, client counter-offer, Reschedule-panel suggestions, VIP decline suggestions, and regular invite/booking decline quick times (backend pytest + Playwright UI on desktop and mobile). Everything requested works. New backend suite: 11/11 passed. Regression suites iter35/iter36 now pass 29/29. They first failed only because their seed used place='own', which the new PLACE_REQUIRED check rejects, so I changed the test seeds to place='other'. UI: every flow passed. Found 2 minor UI issues: the chat button sits on top of open dialogs on mobile, and times can show in mixed clocks when timezones differ.

minor.issue: free_starts() always uses DATE_SLOT_MINUTES (150) to decide which start times fit. A booking with a longer slot_from/slot_to length still has each time checked by _resched_check with the real length, so the results are correct. But the candidate list is built for 150 minutes, so fewer good suggestions may come back. Low impact.

Suggestion date/start use the clock of the original local_day/local_time (the inviter's clock). Busy blocks (_taken_blocks) are grouped by local_day, and each date can be stored in a different person's clock. This mixing of clocks existed before. It only matters when the inviter's and recipient's timezones differ.

ui_bugs.issue: The round chat button shows on top of the open DeclineReasonDialog and covers part of the 'Decline & send reason' button (vs-decline-dialog-confirm). The z-index of the button is above the dialog overlay.

design_issues.screen: /dates invite card (recipient's browser timezone differs from the invite's local clock)
issues: Decline-dialog chips show the owner's local clock (e.g. 'Wed Oct 28 18:00–20:30'). After tapping, the proposal bar resched-proposal-{id} shows the same time in browser time ('Wed, Oct 28, 11:00 PM'). The card header also uses browser time. Same choice, two different clock labels. Show it consistently, e.g. render the proposal bar from local_day/local_time, or add a timezone label.

action_items: LOW: Lower the z-index of the floating chat button, or hide it while a Dialog/Sheet is open (on mobile it covers the dialog footer buttons)
LOW: Show proposal times in the same clock as the suggestion chips (local_day/local_time) so the values match after tapping a chip
Optional: let free_starts take a dur parameter so booking suggestions are built for the booking's real length
critical_code_review_comments: vs_suggest_times counts other bookings' pending proposals as busy and leaves out the booking's own time and its current proposal. Checked: proposal 10:00 blocks 10:00 for the other booking.
VipBookings RescheduleProposal: counter chips show only when canAnswer is true, which is correct. After a client counter, the bar switches to waiting + Withdraw with no chips.
DeclineReasonDialog in DateBookingList: the propose box and suggestUrl are switched off for vip bookings (declineB.vip). Checked in code only; I did not run a VIP price-list UI test.
Backend pytest.ini forces xdist (-n). Run the module-fixture suites with '-n 0', or the seed fixture runs in several workers at once and fails with duplicate emails.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 2 minor design issues

seed_data_creation: Users test_i37_{a,v,r,i}@example.com / Test@12345 (a=client, v=VIP with vip_avail 10-16 UTC on day+3/+4, r=regular recipient with availability_ranges 18-23 days +2..+6, i=inviter), created with seed_iter37.py. The script deletes and re-creates them on each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_iter37_suggest_counter.py -n 0. For UI: python seed_iter37.py prints IDs, then log in by setting localStorage gd_token. VIP tabs use testids vs-tab-{requests,mine,confirmed,review,cancelled,past}; dates tabs use dates-tab-*. Verified in UI: client counter on confirmed (by changes to client, VIP sees Accept/Keep plus own counter chips); counter on pending (instant change, bar removed); vs-book-suggest chips in the Reschedule sheet (sheet closes after a tap); VIP decline dialog chips plus the 'Pick a different time from the calendar' button opening vs-book-dialog; invite decline propose box (chips create a proposal, invite stays INVITATION_SENT, propose button opens reschedule-dialog); booking decline the same. Regression: cancel-loss notes and decline warning render, PLACE_REQUIRED enforced.
